title: HEALPix on both

dataset.name: DKRZ EERIE future ssp245, P1M mean, HEALPix level 7 (Zarr; from gridlook's shipped catalog)

left.label: warp: ortho-cog-viewer
left.note: No cell renderer. The mesh/UV warp renderer takes a raster with a CRS and a geotransform; a HEALPix array is a 1D list of cells with no image to warp. The warp side's DGGS work lives in trend.sst (S2 cells, Parquet aggregates) and is analytical only: it has no path to the screen either.

right.label: cell: gridlook
right.note: Loaded through gridlook.pages.dev until the vendored build is confirmed to reach this host from the sidebyside origin.

gap: The warp side has DGGS on the analysis side (trend.sst: S2 cells plus Parquet) and none on the rendering side; the cell side has DGGS on the rendering side (HEALPix via the Zarr DGGS convention) and nothing on the analysis side. Neither can draw the other's cells.
bridge: A cell renderer that takes (cell id, value) pairs for any DGGS with a cell-to-vertices function: HEALPix from healpix-geo, S2 from s2geometry. HEALPix cell centres through delaunay is the smaller first step; S2 cells from trend.sst Parquet as a second source would make this page shared.
